annotations.title: Look up an article as of a date

description: POINT-IN-TIME: fetch an article AS IT STOOD on a specific date, not the current version. Resolves the consolidated snapshot of `law` in force on `date` (format YYYY-MM-DD) and returns that article's text, tagged with the actual version date. USE THIS whenever the question is about a past moment ("ce cotă de TVA se aplica în iunie 2025", a transaction/deadline in a given year) — lookup_article returns TODAY's text and would answer a dated question wrong. Works for repealed laws too (the reply says when the act was repealed and by what). A common NAME is read from the act that held it on the date ("Codul fiscal" on 2010-01-01 is Legea 571/2003, and the reply says so); a numbered citation is never swapped for another act. Returns an honest not-found when no version covers the date, with the reason and the versions that do exist; never a wrong value.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

paragraph.description: Optional alineat, e.g. '1', to scope the result.

name: lookup_article_at_date
